text:
Ravi (Sales): FYI we have a procurement checklist from BetaCorp — they want SIG/CAIQ, IR timeline, breach notification SLA, and POC pricing. Need a one-pager for tomorrow. Deadline: 10am PT.

Nina (Security): I can own SIG/CAIQ answers. Are they asking for full Private or will VPC be okay?

Ravi (Sales): They prefer VPC with customer-managed KMS but asked if we can do key escrow for the duration of POC.

Tom (Solutions): Key escrow isn't standard. We support BYOK (customer KMS) for VPC POCs. For Private we can discuss HSM integrations. We can offer temporary key-holding under strict controls but need Legal sign-off.

Laura (Legal): Temporary key escrow is high-risk. We can offer an MSA addendum that limits use and liability, but recommend customer retains keys. If BetaCorp insists, we'll require enhanced indemnities and a short security attestation.

Maya (SE): POC infra: 3 dedicated GPUs, 4-week window, demo dataset only (no production data). Pricing: 40% off reserved POC rate + two enablement sessions. I can draft SOW.

Ravi (Sales): Great. Nina, can you include the IR timeline and contact points? They asked whether we notify customers within a fixed SLA (they prefer 48h).

Nina (Security): Our baseline is: triage within 1h, scope/contain in 24h, notify customer within 72h of confirming impact. We can discuss contractually committing to 48h for enterprise with insurer/legal approval, but operationally 72h is what IR can guarantee today. I'll prepare wording that explains operational steps + what 48h commitment would require.

Ravi (Sales): Please put that in plain language for procurement. They want: "How soon will Redwood notify BetaCorp if customer data is impacted?"

Nina (Security): Draft language below: 

```
Incident response summary:
- Initial ack: within 1 hour of detection.
- Triage & scope: 0-24 hours.
- Containment: as soon as feasible (goal within 24 hours).
- Customer notification: within 72 hours of confirmed impact.
- Regulatory notifications: as required by applicable law; Redwood will cooperate with customer requests.
- Post-incident report: provided within 14 days.
Contacts: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
```

Tom (Solutions): Also include SOC2 report link and last pentest date. That helps procurement.

Nina (Security): SOC2 report (redacted) link: https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2025.pdf. Latest pentest: 2025-10-10. I'll attach a short IR playbook excerpt.

Laura (Legal): I'll add contract language options: (A) Standard: "notify within 72 hours"; (B) Enterprise SLA: "notify within 48 hours" subject to higher indemnity and cooperation on forensics. Which should we propose?

Ravi (Sales): Propose (A) standard, offer (B) as negotiable. Procurement usually pushes for the shorter SLA but accepts conditional terms.

Maya (SE): Uploading drafted SOW and POC pricing to sales/poc now. Will mark PII/data-handling constraints.

upload-bot: upload-bot: New files: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/betacorp-sow-1782601234.pdf, https://files.redwood/sales/poc/betacorp-security-bundle-1782601234.zip

Nina (Security): Uploaded SIG/CAIQ answers and IR excerpt: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/sig-caiq-betacorp-1782601234.md. Added notes where controls are available only for Private.

Ravi (Sales): Awesome. Target: send full package to BetaCorp by 09:30 PT tomorrow. Laura, please include the sample contract language. Team — thanks for the quick turnaround :raised_hands:

Tom (Solutions): I'll stand by for any technical follow-ups during the POC kickoff.

Laura (Legal): I'll drop two short clauses (72h and 48h options) into the bundle and add key escrow risk language.

Ravi (Sales): Perfect. Closing loop: Laura + Nina + Maya to finalize docs tonight; I'll send in the morning.

Maya (SE): noted.

Nina (Security): Will also include contact matrix for incident notifications (legal/comms/security).

Ravi (Sales): Thanks everyone.
